Todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. [Regla 2a2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2t)

Todos los competidores deben estar disponibles para scramblear, juecear, runnear o capturar tiempos de lo contrario, serán descalificados de la competencia. [Regla 1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)  [Regla 1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2) 

Each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. [Rule 2a2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2t)

Every competitor must be available for judging, scrambling, running or score taking. Penalty: disqualification from the competition.  [Rule 1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)  [Rule 1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)
